title: Dying Cyborg Sequence
description: Three sequential views of a shaved-head female cyborg in a copper armored vest and torn jeans, shown collapsing, falling, and lying dead on the ground with a bullet hole in her forehead and smoke rising from her mouth.
prompt: Three-panel sequence against pure black background showing a female cyborg with shaved head and facial tattoos. She wears a copper armored chest piece, torn blue jeans, brown boots, and fingerless gloves. First panel shows her standing with smoke coming from her open mouth and a bullet hole in her forehead. Second panel shows her falling backwards. Third panel shows her lying dead on the ground. Highly detailed realistic rendering with dramatic lighting.
